objective: Position diesel vehicles as low-emission and environmentally responsible.
businessContext: Advertising claims conflicted with vehicles fitted with illegal emissions defeat devices.
strategy: Use environmental and compliance claims to differentiate diesel vehicles.
outcomes: FTC orders led to a consumer redress program exceeding $9.5 billion according to its final court summary.
whatFailed: Objective product claims were contradicted by product behavior and regulatory findings.
transferConditions: Use as a warning whenever marketing depends on technical, environmental or compliance claims.
nonTransferConditions: Do not generalize regulatory redress amounts to other claim failures.

sources.title: FTC final court summary on Volkswagen Clean Diesel
sources.methodology: Regulatory case summary and court-supervised consumer-redress reporting.

rights.notes: Only independently written factual metadata and outbound links are redistributed.

review.notes: Claims checked against the linked primary or regulatory source. Evidence grade remains conservative; independent human review is encouraged.
